# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
This corpus is dominated by internal/operations chatter — transport/trailer booking (Raipur, Nagpur, Tirupati trailer brokers), driver coordination, MTC/tag/document courier follow-ups, and personal/unrelated chit-chat (several "Vishal" calls are social/family calls, not sales). The **genuine sales conversations** are a smaller subset, mostly from BSC's inside-sales team (Varsha, Venkatesh and colleagues) fielding inbound enquiries from dealers, fabricators, and contractors across Tamil Nadu and neighbouring states (AP/Telangana/Vizag corridor). These are short, transactional calls — rate quote, size/brand check, negotiation on ₹1–3/kg, and payment/dispatch confirmation — rather than long consultative sales. Given the mix, this KB is built strictly from the calls that show real product/rate/order discussion (Thirisha Murugan, Tirupati Balasubramaniam, V R Earth Movers, Vadivel T S, Uniqcore Balakrishnan/Vinoth, V Kumar, Vasanth Narasimhan, VASUDEVAN K, Vinayaga Steel Pradeep, Velmurugan Subbaiyan, Vigneshwaran Kalidoss, Vidveda Krishnasamy, VJR Developers, Yashil Mayurkumar Shah, Yasar Feroz Godown, Vasudevan Ganesan, Yuvaraj Elumalai, Vijayakumar Annamalai, and similar). Volume of true sales-negotiation calls is moderate, not large — so conclusions below are kept close to what is explicitly said.

## Products & brand ladder
BSC is a **steel stockist/trader**, not a fabricator — company confirms repeatedly "நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல" for items outside their core list.

**Core products actually sold:**
- **TMT rebar ("கம்பி")** — sizes 8mm to 32mm. Brands available: **SAIL ("சேல்")** and **Vizag/Vaisakh (RINL — same mill, two trade names)**. Grade discussion: Fe500/Fe550D often **not available** — "500 stop பண்ணிட்டாங்களா? 500D-ல வெறும் R&L தான் produce பண்ணுவாங்க... 3 months-ஆ production இல்ல" (Velmurugan Subbaiyan). 550D confirmed available via RNL (Yashil Mayurkumar Shah call — "यह grade TMT SE 550D है... RNL से problem नहीं है").
